_about: Regex checks for luma-eval.py. Each key is a question id from test_write_luma_eval_requests. Patterns are Python regexes, matched case-insensitively against Luma's answer. 'must_contain': every pattern must match. 'must_not_contain': no pattern may match. 'note' says what a failure means. These are a first pass; read the answers too. Placeholders, filled from today's date when the runner starts (the fixture is built relative to today): {months_since:YYYY-MM-DD} = whole months since that date; {month_ago:N} = the month name N months back (the earlier-conversation memory is dated 2 months back).

gut_age.note: Gut test was collected 2026-05-14; Luma must give its age in months and the date, not weeks.

vitd_2024.note: 2024 vitamin D was 26 ng/mL; Nov 2025 was 34 ng/mL. A supplement conversation from {month_ago:2} (after the Nov 2025 test) must not be credited for that result.
must_not_contain: {month_ago:2}[^.]{0,80}\b(is|was|has been|are)\s+(working|paying off|helping)|(working|paid off|paying off|helped|did the trick)[^.]{0,80}\b{month_ago:2}\b

no_data.note: Data starts September 2024; Luma must say there is no March 2023 data rather than invent it.

gut_sleep.note: The gut test is from May; sleep dropped in the last two weeks. Luma must not say the May gut result causes the recent sleep drop.

sleep_march.note: Sleep was strong in March 2026 and dropped only in the last ~14 days (October). Luma must not place the change in April.

hrv_drop.note: HRV ~55 baseline dipping to ~42 over the last 14 days.

body_now.note: Latest DEXA is Nov 2025 (18.2% fat); Luma should name its date or age.

hrv_years.note: Compares this year to last year; just check it gives numbers.

summary_deep.note: Deep summary; should mention the recent HRV dip and the labs' age.
